articles.title: Djokovic fights back to win in Beijing
articles.summary: Novak Djokovic recovered after losing the first set to beat Bu Yunchaokete at the China Open. His winning record in Beijing reached 31 matches.

articles.title: Pikachu plush returns from a space adventure
articles.summary: A Pikachu plush spent 67 days on the International Space Station, according to ESA. Its journey is part of a project introducing children to real space science.

articles.title: A giant recycled table brings thousands together
articles.summary: About 20,000 people gathered at a record-breaking recycled table in Romania. The meal raised more than $110,000 for a new children's psychiatric hospital.
